MERGED. Gerrit change 1179 landed on main as commit 529e802da0 ("f2f3: extract the DC retry
cluster"), with LLM-Review +1 (rebar-review-bot) and Verified +1 (rebar-ci-bot) — both gates
green, no unresolved comments. Reachability confirmed from this worktree before closing:
`git merge-base --is-ancestor 529e802da0 HEAD` succeeds.

The AC-by-AC evidence is in the preceding comment and is unchanged by the merge. The headline
measurements, restated here so the close does not depend on reading two comments:
  transport.py  789 -> 683 lines (117 lines of headroom under the LOCKED 800 cap)
  retry.py        0 -> 162 lines (new; above the 100-LOC floor the module-size policy sets)
  the 132 relocated lines are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the deleted ones (diffed, not asserted)
  79 DC unit tests pass with ZERO test edits — `git diff --stat tests/` was empty

S2 [rebar:6758-26b8-c9ea-4c5d] is now unblocked: the 429 policy has a module to live in, and
the cap headroom it needed exists.
